- **Record histories compacted (E3, done).** [`research.py compact-history`](../../../../../../tools/research/history_notes.py) classifies each note as first, substantive (the claim, statement, title, premises, laws, scope, status, readings or vocabulary changed, or a correction, supersession or migration), bookkeeping (rebind, re-point, rehash, receipt, drift, reconciliation, with no substantive cue) or other, and replaces a record's bookkeeping notes by one counting note. 281 of 282 records compacted: 13,485 notes → 3,472 (10,294 condensed; kept: 282 first, 1,987 substantive, 922 other); record JSON 19.7 MB → 11.1 MB. **Where the full notes live:** each record's exact bytes before compaction are stored under `_process/architecture/history/<sha16>/<id>.json`, named in its condensing note and, for schema-2 records, listed in `text_versions`; the receipt lists every record and snapshot.
